A better way to rephrase the question: What day stands out in your head far more than any other?

It's weird, but I don't have a single day that comes to mind. I've had a lot of awesome experiences that might qualify (from highlights on holidays, to days spent in a lover's arms, to days where I've accomplished something challenging), but none of them really seem any better than any of the others in reflection. I know at the time of some of those, the days felt incredible (possibly 'best ever'), but the time that has passed since then has really tempered the exhilaration.

There has been a bunch of really amazing days, so it is hard to say. But, I can distinctly point out last summer as one of the most amazing times of my life. I was a camp councilor and every day was amazing, like my campers in my classes would throw me some crazy curve balls that were pretty hilarious almost every day. I also met a lot of people that still have a big impact on my life today almost a year later. I also fell in love with the one of the other councilors and we ended up being together after camp for a while.

Every day I just felt good about motivating my campers and showing them what was possible with hard work and dedication to the things they love. On top of all of that it was just a really positive experience of every day seeing how you influence some one and how that makes you want to be better to keep setting an example. The whole thing just kind of fills you up with love ya know. Don't get me wrong there are some trials and tribulations but you just move past it and keep going. And every night you go to sleep tiered from a hard days work, there is something very rewarding in that.
